name: d2mz
description: Batch Bruker .d (micrOTOF-Q series, BAF format) to mzML/mzXML converter with lock-mass mass recalibration and precursor re-phasing. Pure Python, standard library only. Reads the raw Bruker .d folders natively, applies automatic mass recalibration and re-phases the precursor masses of MS/MS acquisitions, and writes standard mzML/mzXML files with automated quality control of the converted files.
